SELECT rp.id AS grant_id, rp.tenant_id, ur.user_id AS subject_id, p.resource_id, p.operation_id, rp.effect, TRUE AS active, rp.start_time, rp.expire_time, NULL AS team_id FROM iam_user_role ur JOIN iam_role_permission rp ON rp.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND rp.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN iam_permission p ON p.tenant_id = rp.tenant_id AND p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{subjectId} AND p.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND p.operation_id = #{operationId} AND ur.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ur.active_slot = 1 AND ur.start_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (ur.expire_time IS NULL OR ur.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND rp.status = 'ACTIVE' AND rp.active_slot = 1 AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT trp.id AS grant_id, trp.tenant_id, tmr.user_id AS subject_id, p.resource_id, p.operation_id, trp.effect, TRUE AS active, trp.start_time, trp.expire_time, trp.team_id FROM iam_team_member_role tmr JOIN iam_team_role_permission trp ON trp.tenant_id = tmr.tenant_id AND trp.team_id = tmr.team_id AND trp.team_role_id = tmr.team_role_id JOIN iam_permission p ON p.tenant_id = trp.tenant_id AND p.id = trp.permission_id WHERE tmr.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tmr.user_id = #{subjectId} AND p.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND p.operation_id = #{operationId} AND tmr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND tmr.active_slot = 1 AND tmr.start_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (tmr.expire_time IS NULL OR tmr.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND trp.status = 'ACTIVE' AND trp.active_slot = 1 AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
